compiled_state.title: [worktree-cleanup]: session end and claude-safe do not remove merged/stale worktrees -> orphan worktree dirs accumulate
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** a16d345be601da64e5f60a8974f1b92ca475b296
* **affected area:** worktree lifecycle cleanup — plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe, worktree-cleanup.sh, cleanup-claude-session.sh, resolve-abandoned-worktrees.sh, end-session SKILL.md
* **host:** darwin; worktree parent dir /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (internal dogfooding)

#### Expected Behavior

After a session ends, the session's worktree should be removed once its branch is merged to main. claude-safe (the session wrapper) and/or end-session should remove the worktree directory and prune the git worktree registration so worktrees do not accumulate.

#### Actual Behavior

23 worktree directories are present under /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/. Two distinct orphan classes observed:

(A) TRUE orphan directories not registered in `git worktree list` and lacking a .git entry — pure leftover dirs git cannot prune:
  - cleanup/                       (mtime 2026-05-20)
  - followup/                      (mtime 2026-05-20)
  - worktree-20260318-154530/      (mtime 2026-03-18, ~2.5 months old)

(B) Registered-but-stale worktrees whose branches are FULLY MERGED into main yet were never removed after session end (sample):
  - worktree-20260524-112235, feat/visual-eval-workflow-integration, fix-audit-findings,
    fix/tmpdir-isolation-anti-pattern, worktree-20260528-085216, worktree-20260528-165839,
    hooks-hardening-to-main-20260530, worktree-20260530-185025, fix-f148-pr-b-json-only-retry,
    fix-gate-llm-reviews-on-tests, fixup-pr496-blue-team, fix-g2-and-pr482-nits
  (~12 merged worktrees still present; merge state confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> main`)

### 3. Action History

Observed during interactive session in worktree-20260530-191623. Enumerated via:
  - `git worktree list` (23 entries incl. main, .tickets-tracker, /tmp advisory-lock temp)
  - `ls -d .../digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/*/` (23 dirs on disk)
  - per-branch `git merge-base --is-ancestor` merge classification

#### Impact

Disk + git-metadata accumulation; stale worktrees confuse worktree-aware tooling and slow `git worktree list`. Class (A) cannot be cleaned by `git worktree prune` since git has no record of them.

comments.body: ADVANCED convergence_score=1 (partial). Both lenses fully agree: (1) claude-safe removes only its OWN worktree, TTY-gated (claude-safe:374 + [ -t 0 ]); its header 'lines 12-13: 10+ worktrees auto-cleanup' is DOC-ONLY fiction (grep confirms zero executable worktree-cleanup invocations). (3) Class A unregistered dirs invisible: worktree-cleanup.sh:604 enumerates only 'git worktree list --porcelain'; no find/parent-dir scan; 'git worktree prune' cleans metadata only. Contradiction RESOLVED empirically: worktree-create.sh:156 only PRINTS a Note (no auto-invoke); historical lens's count>=10 invoke at worktree-create.sh:145 does NOT exist. Class B deeper cause (code-tracer, dynamic gate matrix over 22 worktrees + ~/.claude-safe-cleanup.log): worktree-cleanup.sh is never auto-invoked AND its is_clean (246-250 bare git status --porcelain) + age<12h + unpushed gates pin every merged human worktree on untracked session debris (.claude/scratch/, regenerable docs).

comments.body: CORRECTION (integrity): my prior 'contradiction resolved: code-tracer correct' comment was WRONG. Empirical re-check of worktree-create.sh:144-152 shows the auto-invoke DOES exist: line 145 'if WORKTREE_COUNT -ge 10' -> line 150 '"$CLEANUP_SCRIPT" --all --force --include-branches'. The HISTORICAL lens was correct; code-tracer missed the >=10 branch (saw only the >=4 Note at line 156). Synthesized true ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence): CLASS B = (a) worktree-create.sh:144 count regex 'worktree-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}' undercounts (excludes wt-*/fix-* names) so the >=10 session-create trigger is unreliable; AND (b) when it DOES fire, worktree-cleanup.sh keeps every merged human worktree via is_clean (line 565 bare 'git status --porcelain' -> any untracked file like .claude/scratch/ blocks), age<12h (line 629), and unpushed (line 593) gates [code-tracer gate matrix CONFIRMED]. claude-safe:374 post-exit hook handles only its own worktree, TTY-gated (line 112). CLASS A = worktree-cleanup.sh enumerates only 'git worktree list --porcelain' (482/510/603); no filesystem parent-dir scan; 'git worktree prune' is metadata-only. HANDOFF = end-session Step 12 verify-only. Both lenses each had one blind spot; synthesis uses the empirically-verified parts of both.

comments.body: SAFETY REQUIREMENT (user-raised, concurrent active session). Live check: an active sprint runs in worktree-20260528-165839 (.sprint-active marker present). The branch the user named (worktree-20260528-085216) is checked out at path worktree-20260527-171753 (branch!=dir name) and is currently KEEP via 3 gates: not-merged + age 0.1h + dirty(real handoff docs). GAP FOUND: is_claude_active() (worktree-cleanup.sh:356) only checks live-PID .claude-session.lock + lsof cwd; it does NOT honor .sprint-active/.debug-active markers. ADD Axis 5: treat .sprint-active AND .debug-active (and a live .claude-session.lock) as an ABSOLUTE KEEP guard, evaluated FIRST (before merged/clean/age and before Axis-3 scratch-relaxation), so an active sprint/debug worktree can NEVER be reclaimed regardless of merged/clean/age. Test: merged+clean+old worktree WITH .sprint-active -> KEEP. NO worktree names hardcoded anywhere — protection is gate-based. Destructive 'clean existing' step is GATED behind a --dry-run review the user must confirm; abort if any active-marked/dirty/unmerged/recent worktree shows 'remove'.
